item.title: Shootings at school and home in northeastern British Columbia leave 10 dead including shooter
item.description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia (AP) — A shooting at a school in British Columbia left eight dead including a woman whom police believe to be the shooter, while two more people were found dead at a nearby home, Canadian authorities said Tuesday. item.title: UT study finds 85% of Austin homes pose deadly risk to older people during extreme heat, power outages
item.description: Potentially 85% of Austin homes could present a significant risk of death for an elderly person inside if the power goes out during a heatwave, according to new research from The University of Texas at Austin.

item.title: Do basketball coaches look at bracket projections?
item.description: The college basketball seasons all lead up to one of the most anticipated sports events of the year; March Madness. Texas men's basketball barely made the NCAA tournament last year.

item.title: Texas Supreme Court to hear arguments in detransition activist's medical liability lawsuit
item.description: The Supreme Court of Texas will hear arguments Wednesday morning about whether or not a Texas woman's medical liability lawsuit against her former therapist falls within the state's statute of limitations for such litigation.

item.title: Round Rock ISD launches first‑offender program for students caught with THC
item.description: Under Texas Law, possessing a THC concentrate is a felony. Round Rock ISD Police Chief Ryan Urrutia said many students don’t realize that possessing THC constitutes a felony offense.

item.title: Travis and Williamson Counties discuss TWDB grants for flood sirens
item.description: Two Central Texas counties discussed plans and the potential roll out of grant funding from the Texas Water Development Board.

item.title: Lago Vista Police, SWAT response prompts shelter-in-place for residents near American Drive
item.description: The Lago Vista Police Department advised residents in the area of American Drive and Santa Rosa Avenue to shelter-in-place while authorities worked an ongoing investigation.

item.title: Texas Republicans target Sharia Law as threat to Texas in campaign messaging for 2026 primaries
item.description: Congressman Chip Roy, R-Texas, brought down his gavel Tuesday afternoon to start a congressional hearing on Capitol Hill. In his opening statement to the committee, of which he is the chairman, the Texas congressman said there is a growing movement to overthrow the county's legal system and its Constitution. A movement he said is most prevalent in Texas.
